ios.desc:
Finally, one app to organize your entire life. HabitGenius replaces 5 apps - habit tracker, mood journal, expense tracker, focus timer, and diary. Join thousands who transformed their routines.

WHAT IS HABITGENIUS?

Your personal life dashboard. Build routines, understand emotions, control your budget, stay focused, and preserve memories - all in one beautifully designed app.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Choose Your Tracker - Switch between Habit, Mood, Expense, Focus, or Journal
2. Track in Seconds - One-tap logging with smart widgets
3. Discover Insights - Beautiful charts reveal patterns you never noticed

HABIT TRACKER

• 5 Progress Types: Checkbox, Counter, Timer, Stopwatch, Checklist
• 7 Schedules: Daily, weekly, monthly, custom, specific days, yearly
• Streak Tracking with achievement badges
• Heatmap Calendar shows yearly progress
• Smart Reminders with "Mark Done" & "Snooze"

MOOD TRACKER

• One-Tap Logging with 10 customizable mood levels
• Mood Tags identify triggers and patterns
• Visual Calendar with color-coded emotions
• Mood-Habit Correlation reveals how routines affect feelings

EXPENSE TRACKER

• Track Income & Expenses with custom categories
• Multiple Accounts: checking, savings, cards, cash
• Smart Budget Alerts before overspending
• 180+ Currencies with automatic conversion
• Reports: pie charts, cash flow, balance trends

FOCUS TIMER

• Customizable Pomodoro sessions
• 8 Categories: work, study, creative, coding, reading, writing
• Focus Score tracks productivity improvement
• Live Activity - see timer without unlocking

JOURNAL

• Rich Text with bold, italic, headings, colors
• Photo & File Attachments
• Cloud Sync to Google Drive & iCloud
• Writing Streaks build your habit

14+ WIDGETS

• Habit Progress & Streak Overview
• Mood Insights & Calendar
• Expense Balance & Budget Status
• Focus Timer Quick-Start
• Home Screen & Lock Screen sizes

PRIVACY-FIRST

• Face ID & Touch ID lock
• No Account Required
• Data Stays on Device
• Zero Ads, Zero Tracking
• Works Completely Offline

CUSTOMIZATION

• Light, Dark & OLED Themes
• 20 Accent Colors
• 33 Languages
• Custom Categories

FREE VS PRO

Free: 4 habits, unlimited mood & journal, 2 accounts, essential widgets

Pro: Unlimited everything, all progress types, focus timer, cloud backup, advanced analytics, 14+ widgets

LOVED BY USERS
